sources.title: Small CLs | eng-practices
quotes: It’s easier for a reviewer to find five minutes several times to review small CLs than to set aside a 30 minute block to review one large CL.
The CL should include related test code.

quotes: Why Should Code Reviews Be Fast?

sources.title: What to look for in a code review | eng-practices
quotes: The most important thing to cover in a review is the overall design of the CL.

sources.title: Pull Requests - Engineering Fundamentals Playbook
quotes: We should always aim to keep pull requests small.
Start small, it is easier to create a small PR from the start than to break up a bigger one.
include related tests as part of the PR.

quotes: If you can't avoid large PRs, include explanations of the changes in order to make it easier for the reviewer to review the code, with clear comments the reviewer can identify the goal of every code block.
